findings.text: the anchored allowlist case was deleted and no in-repo assertion replaces it, so no committed test fails if the fence re-seeds reckon-anchored-edit or reckon/crew/prompts.py regains with_anchored_edit_instruction; the only falsifier, test_negative_control.py, lives in the run directory and never travels with the repository.

the codex branch still adds ANCHORED_EDIT_SERVER to the worker's MCP flags when backend['anchored_edit'] is true while this node removed the prompt half that steered a codex worker to it, so a run that still sets the flight key is handed a tool it is never told about.

a claude backend with anchored_edit true now falls through to the operator-settings reason although the seeding path and the user-server passthrough it describes are both gone, so the launch record states a cause that can no longer apply.

item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, one commit 2bd648a88f, changed_paths names all ten diff paths including the two deletions, tests and test_logs name the scoped gate and both declared suite arms, baseline_suite and after_suite carry exit 0 with zero failures, and outside_scope is none.

justifications.fit: The changed modules follow their neighbours' style and the surviving comments state the mechanism, but reckon/_backends.py:3314 still assigns a now-unreachable operator-settings reason and :3402 still declares ANCHORED_EDIT_SERVER for codex with no instruction left to steer a worker to it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_worker_fence.py:346 and reckon/crew/prompts.py both lose every anchored symbol, and the run directory's repro_before.out shows the base seeding and instruction against repro_after.out's absent ones.
justifications.reuse: The change only removes code; no added definition re-implements a mechanism the repository owns, and a capability search over reckon/_worker_fence.py and reckon/crew/prompts.py found no parallel owner left behind.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every one of the ten paths in the diff is on the twelve-path declared list, and the declared evidence fragment and figure directory are simply unused.
